text: E1b-01 opened after QE1-001 was read (answered at E1a; nothing rested on the assumption beyond what E1a already reconciled, so no work changes). The 12 cited-quote defects of quotes_resolve.json, read by hand in their files against cite.py: 2 are faults of form, 10 are artefacts of the script. Faults: account-p1.md line 23 sets my English translation in quotation marks beside the Finnish original it translates (suomi/c0098, which resolves); notes-A1.md line 700 quotes a concept label (predators/c0047) and says it is a label. Artefacts: 4 quote a coder or reader return line and take the next sentence's citation (forms/F06, F10, F23, notes-C5 line 564); 4 are model wording in a table beside evidence ids (serial-C5/finding-1-unit.md lines 71 to 74); 1 quotes words of the concept cited just before (forms/F16, pcmasterrace/c0593 holds focus on the plan); 1 is the store's escaped slash (polyamory/c0002 holds /r backslash /place). No cited quote is an invention.

E1b-01 script unresolved_read.py (output unresolved_read.json; first run kept as .superseded-1, which read the old class and so moved nothing): the 2,042 quote spans that resolved to nothing. 983 are JSON field values inside .md files (structure files 927, review-C5 50, verdict-D 4, RETURN-C5 2), not quotes. Of the other 1,059, 975 are found whole once escapes, asterisks and backticks are set aside: participant words 131, forest 31, case accounts 2, readers' and coders' returns 320, operator's texts 5, the run's own other files 486. 84 were left for reading: 52 near a source, 32 nowhere.

E1b-01 scripts unresolved_hand.py and quote_sources_check.py, then reading by hand: the 84 spans. unresolved_hand traces each to its first appearance in the transcripts (two grep runs were stopped as too slow; their empty outputs are kept as unresolved_hand.superseded-1 and -2; the Python run took 30 seconds). Of the 63 in my files: 16 are the operator's or the harness's words, first seen in a message to me; 8 are texts first seen in a tool's output (shelf pages, counts); 8 are literature quotes that the shelf holds word for word once its two columns and line-end hyphens are read through (quote_sources_check.json); 24 are my own earlier wordings quoted as such; 1 is a translation I declared as mine; 2 are small misquotes of the instrument (notes-C1 line 144 has apply for the stage's applying; notes-C1 line 453 has a rivalry for the scheme's A dispute or rivalry); 3 are examples of my own in quotation marks that read like participants' words (_adjudication-B4/boundaries.md line 59, confusions.md line 47, coordinating-rule-A1.md line 32); 1, J's reading rule in notes-B2.md line 5, has no earlier record in any transcript: its first appearance is my own Write at B2a-r1, so the wording is mine as the record stands. Of the 21 in the readers' room models: 11 quote a concept with small changes, 3 paraphrase inside quotation marks (armenia, zootopia, straya), 7 are not in the room's concepts.

E1b-01 script case_missing_read.py (output case_missing_read.json), then reading by hand: quote-check-E1.json's 389 missing case-account strings. The file lists at most ten a room: 13 rooms are capped, holding 289 missing by count and 130 listed, which is the 548 against 389. Sorted: 242 are in the room's coded passages (the raw check missed them on punctuation the coder put inside the closing quote, link markup or inner quote marks); 85 are the coder's own theme or concept labels; 7 are thread titles; 10 are near quotes with link markup removed; 1 is another room's concept (PokemonSage quoting a post held by TheFarLeftSide). Of the 44 read by hand: 5 are the coder's translations beside the Albanian originals (albania); 6 are the coder's own phrases in quotation marks (a counter-reading's wording); 33 are participant words from uncoded items or titles, cited by item id, which the forest drops, so I cannot check them against the raw record. No invention found among the strings I could check.

E1b-01 script labels_read.py (output labels_read.json): the 3,641 spans of my .md files that resolve to a coder's label (3,627 uncited at E1a, 12 more lenient or in parts, 2 item-cited). 3,560 are the second_order field of the JSON exemplar records in the structure files, not quotes. Of the 81 in prose, a seeded 25 read by hand: in my files 16 name a label as a label (a theme by name, or a room note's struck-by line), 1 is a packet's format, and 1 is a defect; in the readers' room models 4 are faithful quotes whose concept text holds link or emphasis markup, 2 paraphrase inside quotation marks (asexuality, smite), 1 cannot be told (norge). The 2 item-cited spans are both defects of mine, carried from the coder's case accounts at D6a-17 and D6a-18: dutch-telling-D6/greece.md line 36 quotes the coder's English for a Greek post (greece/c0126) as a member's words, with no original; form-telling-D6-r2/room-E-paladins.md line 26 quotes April Fools' shenanigans, the coder's wording, where the post (paladins/c0001) says April Fools' Day, so expect shenanigans. My D6 quote check tested quotes against case.md, so it passed both. The 8 item-cited spans of the 2,042 are the field's quotes, found whole in out/field.

E1b-01 the five spot-checks of quotes_resolve.json (seed cd472a6087a223d4), read by hand with cite.py --room --code: Moondye7/c0066 (forms/F19), lebanon/c0105 (F35), fivenightsatfreddys/c0074 (F07, at h+7: the store has 7.15), OnePiece/c0228 (F27, hour 51.18: the store has 51.18), Rainbow6/c0589 (F20, at the close: the store has 73.29). All five hold word for word, with the room, the concept and the hour as the accounts give them.

E1b-01 the clocks. (1) clocks.py at E1a: the concept's created_utc equals the item's in all 115,350 concepts whose item the store holds (and within 60 s in all), and every concept's hour matches its own created_utc. The store's builder (tools/build_store.py) is not in the folder, so I cannot tell whether the coder wrote the concept's time or the build copied it from the item; if copied, the agreement is true by construction. (2) relations_clock.py (output relations_clock.json), the second check, against relations.jsonl: 476 reciprocated pairs of studied rooms that carry one act from both ends; the two coders' concepts lie within 1 hour in 187, within 6 in 142 more, within 24 in 105 more and beyond 24 in 42. Ten pairs drawn by seed and read by hand with cite.py: 5 date one encounter within 2.6 hours and agree with what the words say (anime and satania, europe and formula1, chibears and finland at 0.04 hours, argentina and uruguay, suomi and unitedkingdom); 4 hold different moments of a longer tie (uiuc and uofm, stevenuniverse and yogscast, OnePiece and pathofexile, lakers and nbaspurs); 1 holds two concepts that do not speak of each other (placestart and thebluecorner). No pair dates one encounter apart. One order is unsettled: in suomi a member says I have opened negotiations 0.83 hours before the same member's opening post in unitedkingdom; the concept's label ties it to Argentina's offer, so the words do not settle with whom. (3) Datings in written order: 237 of 598 case chronologies with two or more datings step back at least once; 14 of the 21 arrows name at least one such room among their 2 to 4 named rooms (A21 names none).

E1b-01 links. links_check.py at E1a: links.py and validate.py --links both exit 0 on the 3 files links.py reads (_head.md and the 2 question files). links.py does not read the views, so links_views.py (output links_views.json) applies its own resolver to the 35 text files of out/_views: 537,153 id-shaped tokens, 487 unresolved, all read: 413 in data-structure.tsv are members' words in its material column (363 r/ names, 210 distinct, as typed; 50 tokens such as the D2 logo, N64 and P90); 40 are the proposition ids N01 to N09 in figure-model.md, which propositions.jsonl holds and links.py does not load; 32 are stage names written bare in the generated views (D2 to D6); 1 is a logo name in a reader's line (C53); 1 is r/3ds in relations.tsv, from a store pointer normalised as r/pokemongo and r/3ds, two rooms in one. No id of the model, the scheme or the store fails to resolve.

E1b-01 defects.jsonl: 8 lines appended by out/_analysis/e1b01_defects_lines.py (the ledger now holds 109 lines, 8 of them E1's). Six are the instrument's (my translation in quotation marks at account-p1.md; the two D6 quotes carried from case.md; two small misquotes of the instrument in notes-C1.md; three examples of my own in quotation marks; the readers' five paraphrases in quotation marks), one is provenance (J's reading rule in notes-B2.md has no record before my Write; sure false), and two are the material's (the case accounts' translations and labels in quotation marks; one store pointer that names two rooms). No earlier file is changed.
E1b-01 correction to the line before: of the 8 defects lines, 5 are the instrument's (not 6), 1 is provenance and 2 are the material's; 5 + 1 + 2 = 8, checked against the ledger.

E1b-01 correction to the clocks line: on writing the section I re-read the drawn pair r/argentina and r/uruguay. The nearest r/argentina concept (argentina/c0178) is about the room's own work, not about r/uruguay's call for help (uruguay/c0010), so the two concepts do not speak of one encounter. The ten read: 4 date one encounter close together (anime and satania, europe and formula1, chibears and finland, suomi and unitedkingdom), 4 hold different moments of a longer tie, 2 hold concepts that do not speak of each other (placestart and thebluecorner; argentina and uruguay). Still no pair dates one encounter at two times.
